verse.verse_1: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
verse.verse_2: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
verse.verse_4: Then separate them, one from another,
verse.verse_6: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
verse.verse_7: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
verse.verse_8: Then when the stars become dim;
verse.verse_9: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
verse.verse_10: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
verse.verse_11: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
verse.verse_12: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
verse.verse_13: For the Day of Sorting out.
verse.verse_14: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
verse.verse_15: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_16: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
verse.verse_17: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
verse.verse_18: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
verse.verse_19: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_20: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
verse.verse_21: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
verse.verse_22: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
verse.verse_23: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
verse.verse_24: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
verse.verse_27: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
verse.verse_28: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_29: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
verse.verse_30: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
verse.verse_31: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
verse.verse_32: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
verse.verse_33: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
verse.verse_34: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_35: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
verse.verse_36: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
verse.verse_37: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_38: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
verse.verse_39: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
verse.verse_40: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_41: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
verse.verse_42: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
verse.verse_43: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
verse.verse_44: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
verse.verse_45: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_46: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
verse.verse_47: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_48: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
verse.verse_49: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
verse.verse_50: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
